#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class CF884F : public std::stack<int> {
public:
  CF884F() {}
  void main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    main_logic();
  }

private:
  static const int A = 26, INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
  vector<int> oo, oh; int __ = 1;
  int link(int o, int h) {
    oo[__] = o; oh[__] = h;
    return __++;
  }
  vector<int> ii, jj, cc, ww, ww_;
  vector<int> ae, dd, kk, ff;
  int n_;
  vector<int> pq, iq;
  int cnt;

  void init() {
    oo.assign(1 + m_ * 2, 0);
    oh.assign(1 + m_ * 2, 0);
    ii.resize(m_);
    jj.resize(m_);
    cc.resize(m_ << 1);
    ww.resize(m_);
    ww_.resize(m_);
    ae.assign(n_, 0);
    dd.assign(n_, INF);
    kk.assign(n_, 0);
    ff.assign(n_, 0);
    pq.resize(1 + n_);
    iq.assign(n_, 0);
    cnt = 0;
  }

  int m_ = 0;
  void link_(int i, int j, int c, int w) {
    int h = m_++;
    ii[h] = i; jj[h] = j; cc[h << 1] = c; ww[h] = w;
    ae[i] = link(ae[i], h << 1);
    ae[j] = link(ae[j], (h << 1) | 1);
  }

  bool less(int u, int v) {
    return dd[u] < dd[v] || (dd[u] == dd[v] && kk[u] < kk[v]);
  }

  int i2(int i) {
    i = i * 2;
    return (i > cnt) ? 0 : ((i < cnt && less(pq[i + 1], pq[i])) ? i + 1 : i);
  }

  void pq_up(int u) {
    int i = iq[u], j, v;
    for (; (j = i / 2) > 0 && less(u, v = pq[j]); i = j)
      pq[iq[v] = i] = v;
    pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
  }

  void pq_dn(int u) {
    int i = iq[u], j, v;
    for (; (j = i2(i)) > 0 && less(v = pq[j], u); i = j)
      pq[iq[v] = i] = v;
    pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
  }

  void pq_add_last(int u) {
    pq[++cnt] = u;
    iq[u] = cnt;
    pq_up(u);
  }

  int pq_remove_first() {
    int u = pq[1], v = pq[cnt--];
    if (v != u) {
      iq[v] = 1;
      pq_dn(v);
    }
    iq[u] = 0;
    return u;
  }

  bool dijkstra(int s, int t) {
    std::fill(dd.begin(), dd.end(), INF);
    dd[s] = 0;
    pq_add_last(s);
    while (cnt > 0) {
      int i = pq_remove_first();
      int k = kk[i] + 1;
      for (int o = ae[i]; o != 0; o = oo[o]) {
        int h_ = oh[o];
        if (cc[h_] > 0) {
          int h = h_ >> 1;
          int j = i ^ ii[h] ^ jj[h];
          int d = dd[i] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? ww_[h] : -ww_[h]);
          if (dd[j] > d || (dd[j] == d && kk[j] > k)) {
            if (dd[j] == INF) pq_add_last(j);
            dd[j] = d; kk[j] = k; ff[j] = h_;
            pq_up(j);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return dd[t] != INF;
  }

  int trace(int s, int t) {
    while (t != s) {
      int h_ = ff[t], h = h_ >> 1;
      cc[h_]--; cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
      t ^= ii[h] ^ jj[h];
    }
    return 1;
  }

  int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
    for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
      int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
      dd[j] = std::min(dd[j], dd[i] + ww[h]);
    }
    for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
      int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
      ww_[h] = ww[h] + dd[i] - dd[j];
    }
    int f = 0;
    while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
      f += trace(s, t);
      for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
        int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
        if (dd[i] != INF && dd[j] != INF) {
          ww_[h] += dd[i] - dd[j];
        }
      }
    }
    int cost = 0;
    for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++)
      cost += ww[h] * cc[h << 1 | 1];
    return cost;
  }

  void main_logic() {
    int n; cin >> n; n /= 2;
    n_ = 1 + n + A + 1;
    m_ = n + n * A + A;
    init();

    string s; cin >> s;
    vector<int> bb(n * 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
      cin >> bb[i];
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      link_(0, 1 + i, 2, 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      int j = n*2 - 1 - i;
      int ai = s[i] - 'a';
      int aj = s[j] - 'a';
      for (int a = 0; a < A; a++) {
        int b;
        if (a == ai && a == aj)
          b = max(bb[i], bb[j]);
        else if (a == ai)
          b = bb[i];
        else if (a == aj)
          b = bb[j];
        else
          b = 0;
        link_(1 + i, 1 + n + a, 1, -b);
      }
    }

    std::vector<int> kk(A, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
      int a = s[i] - 'a';
      kk[a]++;
    }
    for (int a = 0; a < A; a++) {
      link_(1 + n + a, n_ - 1, kk[a], 0);
    }

    int ans = -edmonds_karp(0, n_ - 1);
    cout << ans << "\n";
  }
};

int main() {
  CF884F solver;
  solver.main();
  return 0;
}
